continuity_entry.state: Claire has moved away from the window, gathered one approved essential, retained her phone and committed to leave while the controlled transition continues.
continuity_entry.picture_status_rule: This narrative continuity anchor does not promote any unapproved Scene 02 picture candidate.

dialogue_policy.rule: Do not invent explanatory dialogue or public announcements. If dialogue is later approved, use the standardized compact lower-third system and update caption timing before assembly.

entries.story_action: Immediate continuation from Scene 02 S2-10. Claire completes the already-started departure action: she secures and shoulders/carries the approved essential, retains her phone, and commits physically toward the apartment door. Do not reset her at the window.
entries.visual_media: Begin from the approved Scene 02 terminal continuity state in the established apartment axis. Claire identity, robe/peignoir, essential, phone, window orientation, furniture topology and storm state remain locked.
entries.animation_behavior: One bounded real action envelope: close/secure, lift/shoulder, turn toward the exit. Camera locked. Rain, cloud mass, glass reflection and practical light continue as one coherent system behind her.

continuation_contract.allowed_action: finish securing/carrying one approved essential and orient toward the apartment exit

entries.score_cue: 0-8s immediate unresolved entrance; cut with the first structural thinning.

entries.story_action: Claire reaches and opens the apartment door into the established hallway. A simple dark charcoal outer layer may be put on only as a visible, motivated departure action. Before she crosses the threshold, corridor practicals and access indicators change together; lock relays answer farther down the hall.
entries.visual_media: Fixed threshold composition with the same apartment behind Claire and a stable, ordinary Parisian building corridor ahead. Door, frame, hinges, hallway vanishing point and Claire scale are immutable.
entries.animation_behavior: Bounded hand-to-handle action, physically correct door swing and one directional step through the threshold. The lighting anomaly occurs locally in the hallway fixtures; no global flash or floating interface.

continuation_contract.allowed_action: open the apartment door and cross into the identical hallway; optionally put on the approved charcoal outer layer on-screen
forbidden_action: unmotivated completed wardrobe change between frames

entries.score_cue: 8-15s thinned guitar-led passage; expose relay and lock sounds without muting the score.

entries.story_action: Claire moves down the long hallway. One or two anonymous residents cautiously appear at their own doors. Separate access indicators and locks change in an ordered sequence, revealing that unrelated apartments received the same instruction at the same time.
entries.visual_media: Single strong long-axis corridor hero. Claire remains the human anchor; residents are subordinate silhouettes with no identity emphasis and no crowd.
entries.animation_behavior: Use stable Claire progression or a motivated edit between approved states. Animate practical lights, indicator changes and door movements as registered scene events. No A/B oscillation and no fake walking through pan/zoom.
motion_regions: one or two resident door states
entries.score_cue: 15-30s rhythm/strings gather; ordered system events follow the musical build rather than every beat.

entries.story_action: Claire enters the elevator. Before—or immediately after—her hand approaches the ordinary controls, the system selects the ground/lobby route and suppresses or overrides normal choice. The elevator already knows where she is going.
entries.visual_media: Locked elevator interior hero with an ordinary physical panel, floor indicator and believable reflective metal/glass surfaces. No hologram or speculative interface.
entries.animation_behavior: Indicator progression and button state are registered overlays inside their housings. Elevator vibration is conveyed through local practical response and character balance, never whole-frame wobble. Keep camera locked.
entries.score_cue: 30-49s full drums/bass/strings lock in; use the long mechanical passage for descent and controlled anticipation.

entries.story_action: The elevator opens into the lobby. Exit hardware and access control change in a coordinated mechanical sequence, routing occupants outward. A normal building/security terminal displays the same prepared transition language already established in Scene 02. Claire realizes the building itself is participating.
entries.visual_media: Dry lobby interior with exterior rain visible through entrance glass. Preserve plausible lobby architecture and inherit Scene 02 transition motif/iconography exactly; do not invent a competing emblem.
entries.animation_behavior: Animate locks, turnstile/door states, terminal status and local reflections as physically registered events. Brass/peak section supports the building-scale handoff. Camera stays anchored.
entries.score_cue: 49-66s strongest sustained coordination; brass emergence supports the visible handoff.

entries.story_action: Claire reaches the building threshold and sees the rain-dark street reorganizing. Traffic signals synchronize; a corridor is deliberately cleared; transit displays reroute; vehicles slow and change flow without collision or panic.
entries.visual_media: Wide threshold-to-street composition with Claire foreground, wet Paris street midground and readable civic/traffic depth. Use deep semantic planes and source-local reflections.
entries.animation_behavior: Character, rain, vehicles, signals, display changes and wet reflections provide motion before any camera move. Restrained 2.5D parallax is allowed across true depth planes; no global zoom or shake.
entries.score_cue: 66-78s sustained high drive; expand the soundstage as exterior space opens.
sound_events: distant restrained civic radio/PA texture without intelligible exposition

entries.story_action: Public proof. From Claire's profile or over-shoulder view, the same prepared transition status appears across an ordinary municipal/transit display and nearby civic/security systems. Police or security personnel calmly reposition barriers and redirect flow under matching instructions. Authority has changed.
entries.visual_media: Claire plus ordinary public information display and distant civic/security activity. Keep personnel small and procedural. No tanks, riot tableau, invasion imagery, destruction or screaming crowd.
entries.animation_behavior: The reduced musical texture leaves room for a precise diegetic display change and one coordinated barrier/traffic action. UI remains inside the physical screen. Claire's response is restrained recognition, not melodrama.
entries.score_cue: 78-89s rhythm thins to keyboard/percussion/bass; let the visual proof read clearly.

entries.story_action: Claire moves with purpose away from the building and into the reorganized Paris street, phone in hand and the approved essential carried. The city continues operating under coordinated transition control behind and around her. End on forward motion, not another static reveal.
entries.visual_media: Long street hero with stable Claire identity and directional screen geography. Use the accepted terminal state as Scene 04's continuity anchor only after temporal QC.
entries.animation_behavior: True bounded walking continuation is preferred. Camera observes from a locked or explicitly bounded position. If identity or world continuity fails, reject the continuation and use one approved matched destination state as a motivated cut—never fake walking with pan/zoom.

continuation_contract.allowed_action: purposeful bounded walk into Paris with phone and essential retained
continuation_contract.camera_policy: locked or one predeclared restrained observational vector; no orbit or tracking wobble
continuation_contract.terminal_policy: terminal frame requires identity, anatomy, wardrobe, prop, geography, lighting and weather QC before Scene 04 reuse

entries.score_cue: 89-98s unresolved keyboard/synth/bass tail; carry forward without a hard final hit.
sound_events: score tail continuous into Scene 04 or a smooth atmospheric handoff
